title: SCM Control Tower
description: Prototype for the 2027 NPN SCM Hackathon: a single shell for live yard, dock and delivery tracking plus an autonomous procure-to-pay flow.
highlights: Every screen runs off one deterministic, seeded event stream, so the six-minute demo plays identically each time.
Surfaces the source, freshness and confidence of each fact, since WMS, gate, RFID and GPS data rarely agree.
Typed data layer designed so a real backend and AI services can slot in behind it in v1.

title: AI Invoice Reconciliation
description: A local-LLM pipeline that reads invoices and receipts, matches vendors despite OCR noise, and flags mismatches before exporting an Excel report.
highlights: Resolves vendors using profiles, OCR variants, GSTIN and invoice history.
Checks quantity, price and GST/CGST fields against ERP records.
Runs fully on local models, keeping financial documents on-premise.

title: Crowd State Analysis
description: Detects and tracks people in video, then classifies the scene as organized flow, dense crowd or chaotic rush, with a hazard overlay.
highlights: Persistent IDs and trajectories feed metrics such as compactness and flow coherence.
Supports region-of-interest zones and configurable thresholds.
Outputs an annotated video with boxes, paths and live metrics.

title: Space Station Cargo Planner
description: Cargo placement and retrieval algorithms for a space station, built for the National Space Hackathon by IIT Delhi and ISRO (top 10 finalist).
highlights: Octree-based allocation packs items into containers efficiently.
Indexed search reports where an item sits and what blocks it.

title: PCOS Health Support
description: A health-support web app: a React front end with a Flask API serving random-forest models that estimate PCOS risk from clinical inputs.

title: RAG Study Assistant
description: A retrieval-augmented study tool that indexes web pages and answers questions, with generated flashcards and quizzes on top.

title: Customer Support NLP
description: Embeds support queries into one shared space to match intent, classify requests (multi-class and multi-label) and retrieve the closest reply.
